question: Can public Palmer data support an externally defined colony-code environmental-state test that distinguishes persistent local environment from history-dependent demographic information?

requirements: An explicit public source maps Palmer LTER island + colony_code to a polygon, centroid, or unambiguous mapped sub-colony identifier without manual visual guessing.
A public colony-specific environmental measurement or externally defined environmental state exists for multiple breeding seasons overlapping the 1991-2017 performance panel.
The temporal environmental state is measured independently of the penguin reproductive-performance outcome.
dynamic_environment_gate_open.allowed_next_step: Freeze a model adding observed colony-specific environmental state to the performance-memory/redistribution model before opening joined environmental values.

requirements: An explicit public source maps Palmer LTER island + colony_code to a polygon, centroid, or unambiguous mapped sub-colony identifier without manual visual guessing.
Public static terrain or snow-retention attributes can be assigned from that geometry.
A long-term external annual weather series overlaps the performance panel.
static_x_weather_gate_open.allowed_next_step: Freeze a static-terrain x annual-weather interaction model. Label this as a modeled environmental-risk proxy, not observed colony-year snow.

partial_gate.definition: Relevant spatial, snow, terrain, or historical sub-colony data exist, but either the Palmer LTER colony_code crosswalk is not explicit/public or temporal colony-specific environmental coverage is insufficient.

closed_gate.definition: No qualifying public spatial/environmental data can be linked even in principle to the Palmer colony panel.

search_targets: Cimino et al. 2025 Landscape Ecology article and supplementary material
Patterson et al. 2003 / associated Torgersen maps and archived spatial data
Palmer LTER ERDDAP/EDI metadata and spatial datasets
Duke Research Data Repository drone/orthomosaic package DOI 10.7924/r4sf2xs2w
Polar Geospatial Center-linked products where public metadata expose colony identifiers
repository files already present in mina

accepted: table with colony_code and coordinates/polygon ID
GIS attribute table containing the same raw colony_code values used by Palmer LTER
published explicit textual mapping of each relevant raw colony_code to mapped sub-colony ID
rejected: manual matching by figure position, color, apparent ordering, or polygon size
assuming historic sub-colony numbers equal LTER colony_code because counts or ranges look similar
nearest-neighbor assignment from colony centroids without an explicit source bridge
post hoc choosing only colonies whose mapping appears obvious

temporal_environment_acceptance.dynamic_observed: At least 5 overlapping breeding seasons for >=3 mapped colony codes, with season-specific measured snow or another externally measured colony-local environmental state.
temporal_environment_acceptance.static_risk: Static topography/terrain is allowed only for the static_x_weather gate and must be paired with a prespecified external annual weather series.
temporal_environment_acceptance.known_limitation: The 2025 Palmer snow study reports spatial snow maps primarily for 2019 high-snow and 2020 low-snow conditions, outside the main 1991-2017 performance panel; these two maps alone do not open the dynamic_environment gate.

claim_boundaries: Do not generate a colony_code spatial crosswalk by visual inference.
Do not call 2019/2020 snow maps a long-term colony-year environmental series.
Do not use penguin abundance or reproductive success to define environmental risk.
Do not claim a failed public-data audit proves environmental conditions are unimportant.
If only a Torgersen-specific explicit crosswalk is found, freeze any downstream test as a Torgersen external-validation analysis rather than generalizing it to all Palmer islands.
